itemized.notes: 6-page PDF, pages in order: p1 cover (2014 Financial Disclosure Report, County Officeholders - Year-End) / p2 Summary Page / p3 on-form 'Itemized Contributions Received' with 'See attached' / p4 contributions attachment / p5 on-form 'Itemized Expenditures Made' with 'See attached' / p6 expenditures attachment. Both attachments are LANDSCAPE, rendered portrait by poppler and rotated 90 degrees COUNTER-CLOCKWISE to read; each is headed by the filer's handwritten label ('Contributions' / 'Expenditures'). PRIVACY: the contributions attachment's Address column is a solid black COUNTY REDACTION - donor_city/donor_state blank, 'redacted' noted per row. The contributions sheet carries an explicit 'In-Kind?' column which is EMPTY on all three rows, so no row is marked in-kind. Occupation & Employer values are recorded in the row notes (no schema field). The cover checks BOTH the Year-End (January 31) box and the Final/Dissolution box, and marks 'No' to amendment; the listing label 'YearEnd' is consistent. The Summary Page's line 7 closing balance is a zero glyph (a drawn oval), consistent with a dissolution.
